## Service: calendars (Calendars API)

Documentation for Calendars API

### Apply user availability schedule to a calendar
PUT /calendars/schedules/{id}/associations/{calendarId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/schedules/{id}/associations/{calendarId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/add-calendar-to-schedule | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/add-calendar-to-schedule.md

Associates a calendar with the given schedule by adding the calendarId to a schedule

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- id* string (e.g. "IkqiJlXJ7o9h61tCHHod") - Unique identifier of the schedule
- calendarId* string (e.g. "WvVX9LpvlBO6K506xLbp") - Unique identifier of the team calendar to add to the schedule

Response 200 (Calendar successfully added to schedule) application/json:
- success boolean - Whether the operation was successful

Errors: 400, 401, 404
Response 400 (Schedule and calendar must belong to the same location) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
Response 401 (User not authenticated) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
- error string
Response 404 (Schedule or calendar not found) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string

### Create appointment
POST /calendars/events/appointments
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/events/appointments
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/create-appointment | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/create-appointment.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars/events.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) AppointmentCreateSchema:
- title string (e.g. "Test Event") - Title
- meetingLocationType string (enum: custom | zoom | gmeet | phone | address | ms_teams | google; e.g. "custom") - Meeting location type. - If `address` is provided in the request body, the `meetingLocationType` defaults to **custom**.
- meetingLocationId string (default: default; e.g. "custom_0") - The unique identifier for the meeting location. - This value can be found in `calendar.locationConfigurations`or `calendar.teamMembers[].locationConfigurations`
- overrideLocationConfig boolean - Flag to override location config - **false** - If only `meetingLocationId` is provided - **true** - If only `meetingLocationType` is provided
- appointmentStatus string (enum: new | confirmed | cancelled | showed | noshow | invalid | completed | active; e.g. "confirmed") - Appointment status
- assignedUserId string (e.g. "0007BWpSzSwfiuSl0tR2") - Assigned User Id
- description string (e.g. "Booking a call to discuss the project") - Appointment Description
- address string (e.g. "Zoom") - Appointment Address
- ignoreDateRange boolean - If set to true, the minimum scheduling notice and date range would be ignored
- toNotify boolean (default: true) - If set to false, the automations will not run. Defaults to true
- ignoreFreeSlotValidation boolean - If true the time slot validation would be avoided for any appointment creation (even the ignoreDateRange)
- rrule string (e.g. "RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1;COUNT=5") - RRULE as per the iCalendar (RFC 5545) specification for recurring events. DTSTART is not required, instance ids are calculated on the basis of startTime of the event. The rrule only be applied if ignoreFreeSlotValidation is true.
- calendarId* string (e.g. "CVokAlI8fgw4WYWoCtQz") - Calendar Id
- locationId* string (e.g. "C2QujeCh8ZnC7al2InWR") - Location Id
- contactId* string (e.g. "0007BWpSzSwfiuSl0tR2") - Contact Id
- startTime* string (e.g. "2021-06-23T03:30:00+05:30") - Start Time
- endTime string (e.g. "2021-06-23T04:30:00+05:30") - End Time

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- calendarId* string - Calendar Id
- locationId* string - Location Id
- contactId* string - Contact Id
- startTime string - Start Time
- endTime string - End Time
- title string - Title
- meetingLocationType string (default: default) - Meeting Location Type
- appointmentStatus string (enum: new | confirmed | cancelled | showed | noshow | invalid | active | completed) - Appointment status
- assignedUserId string - Assigned User Id
- address string - Appointment Address
- isRecurring boolean - true if the event is recurring otherwise false
- rrule string - RRULE as per the iCalendar (RFC 5545) specification for recurring events
- dateAdded* string - Date Added
- dateUpdated* string - Date Updated
- id* string - Id

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Create event calendar availability schedule
POST /calendars/schedules/event-calendar/{calendarId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/schedules/event-calendar/{calendarId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/create-calendar-schedule | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/create-calendar-schedule.md

Create a new availability schedule specifically for an event calendar. The calendar ID is provided in the path, and schedule rules and timezone are provided in the request body.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- calendarId* string (e.g. "WvVX9LpvlBO6K506xLbp") - Unique identifier of the event calendar

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateEventCalendarScheduleDTO:
- rules* object[] - Schedule rules defining when the schedule is active
  - type* string (enum: wday | date; e.g. "wday") - Type of schedule rule - weekday (recurring) or date (specific date)
  - intervals* object[] - Time intervals for the rule (e.g., 9 AM to 5 PM)
    - from* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$; e.g. "09:00") - Start time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
    - to* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$; e.g. "17:00") - End time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
  - date string (pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$; e.g. "2023-04-15") - Specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format (only for date-type rules)
  - day string (enum: sunday | monday | tuesday | wednesday | thursday | friday | saturday; e.g. "monday") - Day of week (only for weekday-type rules)
- timezone* string (pattern: ^[A-Za-z_]+/[A-Za-z_]+$; e.g. "America/New_York") - Timezone for the schedule (IANA timezone identifier)

Response 201 (Schedule created successfully for the event calendar) application/json:
- schedule* object - The event calendar schedule
  - timezone* string - Timezone for the schedule (IANA timezone identifier)
  - rules* object[] - Schedule rules defining when the schedule is active
    - type* string (enum: wday | date) - Type of schedule rule - weekday (recurring) or date (specific date)
    - intervals* object[] - Time intervals for the rule (e.g., 9 AM to 5 PM)
      - from* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$) - Start time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
      - to* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$) - End time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
    - date string (pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$) - Specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format (only for date-type rules)
    - day string (enum: sunday | monday | tuesday | wednesday | thursday | friday | saturday) - Day of week (only for weekday-type rules)
  - calendarId* string - Calendar ID associated with the schedule
  - dateAdded string - Information about who created the schedule
  - dateUpdated string - Information about who last updated the schedule

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 422
Response 400 (Invalid request parameters) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
Response 401 (User not authenticated) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
- error string
Response 404 (Event calendar with the specified ID was not found): no body
Response 422 (Validation errors in schedule rules or conflicting data) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string[]
- error string

### Create notification
POST /calendars/{calendarId}/notifications
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/{calendarId}/notifications
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/create-event-notification | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/create-event-notification.md

Create Calendar notifications, either one or multiple. All notification settings must be for single calendar only

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars/events.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- calendarId* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - Calendar ID

Request body (required) (application/json):
- (root) object[]
  - receiverType* string (enum: contact | guest | assignedUser | emails | phoneNumbers | business; e.g. "user") - notification recipient type
  - channel* string (enum: email | inApp | sms | whatsapp; e.g. "email") - Notification channel
  - notificationType* string (enum: booked | confirmation | cancellation | reminder | followup | reschedule; e.g. "confirmation") - Notification type
  - isActive boolean (default: true) - Is the notification active
  - templateId string (e.g. "MwPcayliwcdoUFzvbTok") - Template ID for email notification. Not necessary for in-App notification
  - body string (e.g. "Your appointment has been confirmed.") - Body for email notification. Not necessary for in-App notification
  - subject string (e.g. "Appointment Confirmation") - Subject for email notification. Not necessary for in-App notification
  - afterTime object[] - Specifies the time after which the follow-up notification should be sent. This is not required for other notification types.
    - timeOffset number (e.g. 1) - Time offset value for the notification schedule
    - unit string (e.g. "hours") - Unit of time for the offset
  - beforeTime object[] - Specifies the time before which the reminder notification should be sent. This is not required for other notification types.
    - timeOffset number (e.g. 1) - Time offset value for the notification schedule
    - unit string (e.g. "hours") - Unit of time for the offset
  - additionalEmailIds string[] (e.g. ["example1@email.com","example2@email.com"]) - Additional email addresses to receive notifications.
  - additionalPhoneNumbers string[] (e.g. ["+919876744444","+919876744445"]) - Additional phone numbers to receive notifications.
  - selectedUsers string[] (e.g. ["userId1","userId2","sub_account_admin"]) - Selected users for in-App and business email notifications. Supports user IDs and special keyword "sub_account_admin"
  - fromAddress string (e.g. "notifications@example.com") - from address for email notification
  - fromName string (e.g. "Acme Scheduling") - from name for email/sms notification
  - fromNumber string (e.g. "+15551234567") - from number for sms notification

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- (root) object[]
  - _id string - Notification ID
  - receiverType string (enum: contact | guest | assignedUser | emails | phoneNumbers | business) - Notification recipient type
  - additionalEmailIds string[] - Additional email addresses to receive notifications
  - additionalPhoneNumbers string[] - Additional phone numbers to receive notifications
  - channel string (enum: email | inApp | sms | whatsapp) - Notification channel
  - notificationType string (enum: booked | confirmation | cancellation | reminder | followup | reschedule) - Notification type
  - isActive boolean - Whether the notification is active
  - additionalWhatsappNumbers string[] - Additional WhatsApp numbers to receive notifications
  - templateId string - Template ID for the notification
  - body string - Notification body content
  - subject string - Notification subject line
  - afterTime object[] - Time schedules after which follow-up notifications are sent
    - timeOffset number - Time offset value for the notification schedule
    - unit string - Unit of time for the offset
  - beforeTime object[] - Time schedules before which reminder notifications are sent
    - timeOffset number - Time offset value for the notification schedule
    - unit string - Unit of time for the offset
  - selectedUsers string[] - Selected user IDs for the notification
  - deleted boolean - Whether the notification is deleted

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Update Appointment
PUT /calendars/events/appointments/{eventId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/events/appointments/{eventId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/edit-appointment | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/edit-appointment.md

Update appointment

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars/events.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- eventId* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - Event Id or Instance id. For recurring appointments send masterEventId to modify original series.

Request body (required) (application/json) AppointmentEditSchema:
- title string (e.g. "Test Event") - Title
- meetingLocationType string (enum: custom | zoom | gmeet | phone | address | ms_teams | google; e.g. "custom") - Meeting location type. - If `address` is provided in the request body, the `meetingLocationType` defaults to **custom**.
- meetingLocationId string (default: default; e.g. "custom_0") - The unique identifier for the meeting location. - This value can be found in `calendar.locationConfigurations`or `calendar.teamMembers[].locationConfigurations`
- overrideLocationConfig boolean - Flag to override location config - **false** - If only `meetingLocationId` is provided - **true** - If only `meetingLocationType` is provided
- appointmentStatus string (enum: new | confirmed | cancelled | showed | noshow | invalid | completed | active; e.g. "confirmed") - Appointment status
- assignedUserId string (e.g. "0007BWpSzSwfiuSl0tR2") - Assigned User Id
- description string (e.g. "Booking a call to discuss the project") - Appointment Description
- address string (e.g. "Zoom") - Appointment Address
- ignoreDateRange boolean - If set to true, the minimum scheduling notice and date range would be ignored
- toNotify boolean (default: true) - If set to false, the automations will not run. Defaults to true
- ignoreFreeSlotValidation boolean - If true the time slot validation would be avoided for any appointment creation (even the ignoreDateRange)
- rrule string (e.g. "RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1;COUNT=5") - RRULE as per the iCalendar (RFC 5545) specification for recurring events. DTSTART is not required, instance ids are calculated on the basis of startTime of the event. The rrule only be applied if ignoreFreeSlotValidation is true.
- calendarId string (e.g. "CVokAlI8fgw4WYWoCtQz") - Calendar Id
- startTime string (e.g. "2021-06-23T03:30:00+05:30") - Start Time
- endTime string (e.g. "2021-06-23T04:30:00+05:30") - End Time

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- calendarId* string - Calendar Id
- locationId* string - Location Id
- contactId* string - Contact Id
- startTime string - Start Time
- endTime string - End Time
- title string - Title
- meetingLocationType string (default: default) - Meeting Location Type
- appointmentStatus string (enum: new | confirmed | cancelled | showed | noshow | invalid | active | completed) - Appointment status
- assignedUserId string - Assigned User Id
- address string - Appointment Address
- isRecurring boolean - true if the event is recurring otherwise false
- rrule string - RRULE as per the iCalendar (RFC 5545) specification for recurring events
- dateAdded* string - Date Added
- dateUpdated* string - Date Updated
- id* string - Id

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### List user availability schedule
GET /calendars/schedules/search
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/schedules/search
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/get-all-schedules | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/get-all-schedules.md

Retrieve user availability schedules based on various filters including location, calendar, and user. Supports pagination.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "IkqiJlXJ7o9h61tCHHod") - Location ID to filter schedules by
- userId* string (e.g. "IkqiJlXJ7o9h61tCHHod") - User ID to filter schedules by specific user
- calendarId string (e.g. "WvVX9LpvlBO6K506xLbp") - Calendar ID for filtering schedules by specific calendar
- skip number (default: 0; min: 0) - Number of items to skip for pagination
- limit number (default: 50; min: 1; max: 500) - Maximum number of items to return (max 500)

Response 200 (Schedules retrieved successfully) application/json:
- schedules* object[] - Array of schedules
  - id* string - Unique identifier for the schedule
  - name* string - Human-readable name for the schedule
  - locationId* string - Location ID where this schedule applies
  - rules* object[] - Schedule rules defining when the schedule is active
    - type* string (enum: wday | date) - Type of schedule rule - weekday (recurring) or date (specific date)
    - intervals* object[] - Time intervals for the rule (e.g., 9 AM to 5 PM)
      - from* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$) - Start time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
      - to* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$) - End time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
    - date string (pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$) - Specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format (only for date-type rules)
    - day string (enum: sunday | monday | tuesday | wednesday | thursday | friday | saturday) - Day of week (only for weekday-type rules)
  - timezone* string - Timezone for the schedule (IANA timezone identifier)
  - dateAdded* string - ISO date string when the schedule was created
  - dateUpdated* string - ISO date string when the schedule was last updated
  - userId* string - User ID associated with the schedule
  - calendarIds string[] - Calendar IDs associated with the schedule
  - deleted* boolean - Whether the schedule has been deleted

Errors: 400, 401
Response 400 (Invalid request parameters) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
Response 401 (User not authenticated) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
- error string

### Get event calendar availability schedule
GET /calendars/schedules/event-calendar/{calendarId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/schedules/event-calendar/{calendarId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/get-calendar-schedule | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/get-calendar-schedule.md

Retrieve the availability schedule for a specific event calendar. Returns the schedule associated with the calendar ID provided in the path.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- calendarId* string (e.g. "WvVX9LpvlBO6K506xLbp") - Unique identifier of the event calendar

Response 200 (Schedule retrieved successfully for the event calendar) application/json:
- schedule* object - The event calendar schedule
  - timezone* string - Timezone for the schedule (IANA timezone identifier)
  - rules* object[] - Schedule rules defining when the schedule is active
    - type* string (enum: wday | date) - Type of schedule rule - weekday (recurring) or date (specific date)
    - intervals* object[] - Time intervals for the rule (e.g., 9 AM to 5 PM)
      - from* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$) - Start time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
      - to* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$) - End time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
    - date string (pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$) - Specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format (only for date-type rules)
    - day string (enum: sunday | monday | tuesday | wednesday | thursday | friday | saturday) - Day of week (only for weekday-type rules)
  - calendarId* string - Calendar ID associated with the schedule
  - dateAdded string - Information about who created the schedule
  - dateUpdated string - Information about who last updated the schedule

Errors: 400, 401, 404
Response 400 (Invalid request parameters) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
Response 401 (User not authenticated) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
- error string
Response 404 (Event calendar or schedule with the specified ID was not found): no body

### Get user availability schedule
GET /calendars/schedules/{id}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/schedules/{id}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/get-schedule-by-id | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/get-schedule-by-id.md

Retrieve a specific schedule by its unique identifier. Returns detailed information including rules, timezone, and associated calendars/users.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- id* string (e.g. "IkqiJlXJ7o9h61tCHHod") - Unique identifier of the schedule

Response 200 (Schedule found and retrieved successfully) application/json:
- schedule* object - Schedule
  - id* string - Unique identifier for the schedule
  - name* string - Human-readable name for the schedule
  - locationId* string - Location ID where this schedule applies
  - rules* object[] - Schedule rules defining when the schedule is active
    - type* string (enum: wday | date) - Type of schedule rule - weekday (recurring) or date (specific date)
    - intervals* object[] - Time intervals for the rule (e.g., 9 AM to 5 PM)
      - from* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$) - Start time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
      - to* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$) - End time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
    - date string (pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$) - Specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format (only for date-type rules)
    - day string (enum: sunday | monday | tuesday | wednesday | thursday | friday | saturday) - Day of week (only for weekday-type rules)
  - timezone* string - Timezone for the schedule (IANA timezone identifier)
  - dateAdded* string - ISO date string when the schedule was created
  - dateUpdated* string - ISO date string when the schedule was last updated
  - userId* string - User ID associated with the schedule
  - calendarIds string[] - Calendar IDs associated with the schedule
  - deleted* boolean - Whether the schedule has been deleted

Errors: 400, 401, 404
Response 400 (Invalid request parameters) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
Response 401 (User not authenticated) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
- error string
Response 404 (Schedule with the specified ID was not found): no body

### Get Free Slots
GET /calendars/{calendarId}/free-slots
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/{calendarId}/free-slots
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/get-slots | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/get-slots.md

Get free slots for a calendar between a date range. Optionally a consumer can also request free slots in a particular timezone and also for a particular user.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- calendarId* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - Calendar Id

Query parameters:
- startDate* number (e.g. 1548898600000) - Start Date (**⚠️ Important:** Date range cannot be more than 31 days)
- endDate* number (e.g. 1601490599999) - End Date (**⚠️ Important:** Date range cannot be more than 31 days)
- timezone string (e.g. "America/Chihuahua") - The timezone in which the free slots are returned
- userId string (e.g. "082goXVW3lIExEQPOnd3") - The user for whom the free slots are returned
- userIds string[] (e.g. ["082goXVW3lIExEQPOnd3"]) - The users for whom the free slots are returned
- duration number (e.g. 30) - Duration in minutes to use for slot calculation. Must match one of the active durationOptions on the calendar. If omitted, the default duration is used.

Response 200 (Availability map keyed by date (YYYY-MM-DD)) application/json:
- (root) map<string, object>
  - slots* string[] - Available time slots in ISO 8601 format

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Update Calendar
PUT /calendars/{calendarId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/{calendarId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/update-calendar | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/update-calendar.md

Update calendar by ID.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- calendarId* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - Calendar Id

Request body (required) (application/json) CalendarUpdateDTO:
- notifications object[] (deprecated) - 🚨 Deprecated! Please use 'Calendar Notifications APIs' instead.
  - type string (enum: email; default: email) - Calendar Notification
  - shouldSendToContact* boolean - Send notification to contact
  - shouldSendToGuest* boolean - Send notification to guest
  - shouldSendToUser* boolean - Send notification to user
  - shouldSendToSelectedUsers* boolean - Send notification to selected users
  - selectedUsers* string (e.g. "user1@testemail.com,user2@testemail.com") - Comma separated emails
- groupId string (e.g. "BqTwX8QFwXzpegMve9EQ") - Group Id
- teamMembers object[] - Team members are required for calendars of type: Round Robin, Collective, Class, Service. Personal calendar must have exactly one team member.
  - userId* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - User ID of the team member
  - priority number (enum: 0 | 0.5 | 1; default: 0.5) - Priority of the team member for round robin
  - meetingLocationType string (enum: custom | zoom | gmeet | phone | address | teams | booker; default: custom; deprecated; read-only) - 🚨 Deprecated! Use `locationConfigurations.kind` instead.
  - meetingLocation string (deprecated; read-only) - 🚨 Deprecated! Use `locationConfigurations.location` instead.
  - isPrimary boolean - Marks a user as primary. This property is required in case of collective booking calendars. Only one user can be primary.
  - locationConfigurations object[] - Meeting location configuration for event calendar. - *Multiple locations are allowed only when one team member is selected.* - *For **Class booking** and **Collective** calendars, only one location configuration is allowed for each team member.*
    - kind* string (enum: custom | zoom_conference | google_conference | inbound_call | outbound_call | physical | booker | ms_teams_conference; e.g. "custom") - Type of meeting location. zoom_conference/google_conference/ms_teams_conference is not supported in event calendar type
    - location string (e.g. "https://meet.google.com/abc-def") - Address for meeting location. Not applicable on "zoom_conference", "google_conference" and "ms_teams_conference" kind
- eventType string (enum: RoundRobin_OptimizeForAvailability | RoundRobin_OptimizeForEqualDistribution; e.g. "RoundRobin_OptimizeForAvailability") - Event type for round robin distribution
- name string (e.g. "test calendar") - Calendar name
- description string (e.g. "this is used for testing") - Calendar description
- slug string (e.g. "test1") - Calendar slug for URL
- widgetSlug string (e.g. "test1") - Widget slug
- widgetType string (enum: default | classic; default: classic) - Calendar widget type. Choose "default" for "neo" and "classic" for "classic" layout.
- eventTitle string (e.g. "{{contact.name}}") - Title for calendar events
- eventColor string (default: #039be5; e.g. "#039BE5") - Color for calendar events in hex format
- locationConfigurations object[] - Meeting location configuration for event calendar
  - kind* string (enum: custom | zoom_conference | google_conference | inbound_call | outbound_call | physical | booker | ms_teams_conference; e.g. "custom") - Type of meeting location. zoom_conference/google_conference/ms_teams_conference is not supported in event calendar type
  - location string (e.g. "https://meet.google.com/abc-def") - Address for meeting location. Not applicable on "zoom_conference", "google_conference" and "ms_teams_conference" kind
- meetingLocation string (deprecated; read-only) - 🚨 Deprecated! Use `locationConfigurations.location` or `teamMembers[].locationConfigurations.location` instead.
- slotDuration number (default: 30) - This controls the duration of the meeting
- slotDurationUnit string (enum: mins | hours; e.g. "mins") - Unit for slot duration.
- durationOptions object[] - Multiple duration options for the calendar. Bookers can select their preferred meeting length. Max 3 options. Exactly one must be marked as default.
  - duration* number (e.g. 30) - Duration value in minutes
  - durationUnit* string (enum: mins | hours; e.g. "mins") - Unit for the duration
  - isDefault* boolean - Whether this is the default (pre-selected) duration
  - order* number (e.g. 1) - Display order of the duration pill (1-based)
- preBufferUnit string (enum: mins | hours; e.g. "mins") - Unit for pre-buffer.
- slotInterval number (default: 30) - Slot interval reflects the amount of time the between booking slots that will be shown in the calendar.
- slotIntervalUnit string (enum: mins | hours; e.g. "mins") - Unit for slot interval.
- slotBuffer number (e.g. 15) - Slot-Buffer is additional time that can be added after an appointment, allowing for extra time to wrap up
- preBuffer number (e.g. 10) - Pre-Buffer is additional time that can be added before an appointment, allowing for extra time to get ready
- appoinmentPerSlot number (e.g. 1) - Deprecated: use appointmentPerSlot instead. Maximum bookings per slot (per user)
- appoinmentPerDay number (e.g. 8) - Number of appointments that can be booked for a given day
- allowBookingAfter number (e.g. 4) - Minimum scheduling notice for events
- allowBookingAfterUnit string (enum: hours | days | weeks | months | mins; e.g. "days") - Unit for minimum scheduling notice
- allowBookingFor number (e.g. 30) - Minimum number of days/weeks/months for which to allow booking events
- allowBookingForUnit string (enum: days | weeks | months; e.g. "days") - Unit for controlling the duration for which booking would be allowed for
- countAvailableDaysOnly boolean (default: false) - When true, only days with configured availability count toward the date range booking window

### Update event calendar availability schedule
PUT /calendars/schedules/event-calendar/{calendarId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/schedules/event-calendar/{calendarId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/update-calendar-schedule | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/update-calendar-schedule.md

Update the availability schedule for a specific event calendar. Only provided fields will be updated. The calendar ID is provided in the path.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- calendarId* string (e.g. "WvVX9LpvlBO6K506xLbp") - Unique identifier of the event calendar

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateEventCalendarScheduleDTO:
- rules object[] - Updated schedule rules defining when the schedule is active
  - type* string (enum: wday | date; e.g. "wday") - Type of schedule rule - weekday (recurring) or date (specific date)
  - intervals* object[] - Time intervals for the rule (e.g., 9 AM to 5 PM)
    - from* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$; e.g. "09:00") - Start time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
    - to* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$; e.g. "17:00") - End time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
  - date string (pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$; e.g. "2023-04-15") - Specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format (only for date-type rules)
  - day string (enum: sunday | monday | tuesday | wednesday | thursday | friday | saturday; e.g. "monday") - Day of week (only for weekday-type rules)
- timezone string (pattern: ^[A-Za-z_]+/[A-Za-z_]+$; e.g. "America/Los_Angeles") - Updated timezone for the schedule (IANA timezone identifier)

Response 200 (Schedule updated successfully for the event calendar) application/json:
- schedule* object - The event calendar schedule
  - timezone* string - Timezone for the schedule (IANA timezone identifier)
  - rules* object[] - Schedule rules defining when the schedule is active
    - type* string (enum: wday | date) - Type of schedule rule - weekday (recurring) or date (specific date)
    - intervals* object[] - Time intervals for the rule (e.g., 9 AM to 5 PM)
      - from* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$) - Start time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
      - to* string (pattern: ^([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$) - End time in HH:MM format (24-hour format)
    - date string (pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$) - Specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format (only for date-type rules)
    - day string (enum: sunday | monday | tuesday | wednesday | thursday | friday | saturday) - Day of week (only for weekday-type rules)
  - calendarId* string - Calendar ID associated with the schedule
  - dateAdded string - Information about who created the schedule
  - dateUpdated string - Information about who last updated the schedule

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 422
Response 400 (Invalid request parameters) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
Response 401 (User not authenticated) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
- error string
Response 404 (Event calendar or schedule with the specified ID was not found): no body
Response 422 (Validation errors in schedule rules or conflicting data) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string[]
- error string

Update Event notification by id

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars/events.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- calendarId* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - Calendar ID
- notificationId* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - Notification ID

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateCalendarNotificationsDTO:
- receiverType string (enum: contact | guest | assignedUser | emails | phoneNumbers | business; e.g. "user") - Notification recipient type
- additionalEmailIds string[] (e.g. ["example1@email.com","example2@email.com"]) - Additional email addresses to receive notifications.
- additionalPhoneNumbers string[] (e.g. ["+919876744444","+919876744445"]) - Additional phone numbers to receive notifications.
- selectedUsers string[] (e.g. ["userId1","userId2","sub_account_admin"]) - Selected users for in-App and business email notifications. Supports user IDs and special keyword "sub_account_admin"

- subject string (e.g. "Appointment Confirmation") - Subject for email notification. Not necessary for in-App notification
- afterTime object[] - Specifies the time after which the follow-up notification should be sent. This is not required for other notification types.
  - timeOffset number (e.g. 1) - Time offset value for the notification schedule
  - unit string (e.g. "hours") - Unit of time for the offset

- fromNumber string (e.g. "+15551234567") - from number for sms notification
- fromName string (e.g. "Acme Scheduling") - From name for email/sms notification

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars/events.write

- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- bookingId* string (e.g. "IkqiJlXJ7o9h61tCHHod") - Unique Service Booking ID

Query parameters:
- overrideAvailability boolean (default: false) - If true the time slot validation would be avoided for any booking creation/update (even the skipSchedulingNotice)
- skipSchedulingNotice boolean (default: false) - If set to true, the minimum scheduling notice and date range would be ignored

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateServiceBookingDTO:
- serviceLocationId string (e.g. "65e5f6dfacf123513228d384") - Service Location ID
- meetingLocation string (e.g. "123 Main St, Anytown, USA") - Meeting Location (If service location is an ask the booker, then the meeting location is required)
- title string (e.g. "Service Appointment") - Title
- status string (enum: confirmed | cancelled | invalid | new | showed | noshow; e.g. "confirmed") - Status
- startTime string (e.g. "2021-06-23T03:30:00+05:30") - Start Time
- endTime string (e.g. "2023-09-25T16:30:00+05:30") - End Time
- timezone string (e.g. "America/New_York") - Timezone
- services object[] - If provided, services sent in the request will replace the existing services in the booking.
  - id* string (e.g. "a3b4c5d6e7f8901234567890") - Service ID
  - staffId string (e.g. "8MkU36Wps2w5bRbuGtw3") - Staff ID
  - position number (e.g. 0) - Position
  - addOns object[] - Add-ons
    - id* string (e.g. "6985f6dfacf123513228d384") - Add-on ID
    - quantity number (e.g. 2) - Add-on quantity
    - duration number (e.g. 30) - Add-on duration (in minutes)

Response 200 (Booking updated successfully) application/json:
- bookingId* string - Booking ID
- locationId* string - Location ID
- contactId* string - Contact ID
- serviceLocationId* string - Service Location ID
- title* string - Service Booking Title
- startTime* string - Start Time
- endTime* string - End Time
- services* object[] - Services
  - id* string - Service ID
  - serviceCategoryId* string - Service Category ID
  - serviceStaffId* string - Service Staff ID
  - serviceStartTime* string - Service Start Time
  - serviceEndTime* string - Service End Time
  - serviceResources object[] - Service Resources
    - id* string - Resource ID
  - serviceAddOns object[] - Service Add-ons
    - id* string - Add-on ID
    - quantity number - Add-on quantity
- timezone* string - Timezone
- status* string - Status
- deleted* boolean - Tells if the booking is deleted
- dateAdded* string - Date Added
- dateUpdated* string - Date Updated
- createdBy* object - Booking booked by metadata
  - userId string - The ID of the user who created or updated the appointment
  - source* string - The source of the appointment
- meetingLocation string - Meeting Location (If service location is an ask the booker, then the meeting location is used for the booking)
- messages any[][] - Optional informative or warning messages (e.g. meeting location ignored for non-ask-booker locations)

Errors: 400, 401 (400: see Common error responses)
Response 401 (User not authenticated) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
- error string

### Update Service
PUT /calendars/services/catalog/{serviceId}

Path parameters:

- eventColor string (e.g. "#66C61C") - Service event color (hex)

- serviceCategoryId string (e.g. "65e5f6dfacf123513228d381") - Service category ID

  - payment object - Payment details

    - deposit number (e.g. 20) - Deposit amount or percentage value
    - depositType string (enum: percentage | amount; e.g. "amount") - Deposit type

### Update Service Location
PUT /calendars/services/locations/{serviceLocationId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/calendars/services/locations/{serviceLocationId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/update-service-location | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/calendars/update-service-location.md

Update an existing service location

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: calendars.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- serviceLocationId* string (e.g. "IkqiJlXJ7o9h61tCHHod") - Unique Service Location ID

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateServiceLocationDTO:
- name string (e.g. "California Location") - Location name
- slug string (e.g. "midtown-wellness-therapy-studio") - Updated URL-friendly slug identifier
- phone string (e.g. "+1-212-555-0199") - Updated contact phone number
- address string (e.g. "789 5th Avenue, Floor 5, New York, NY 10022") - Use a full street address when locationType is offline. Use a user-facing label when locationType is ask_booker.
- coverImage string (e.g. "https://storage.example.com/locations/midtown-wellness-studio/cover-v2.jpg") - Updated URL of the cover image
- locationType string (enum: offline | ask_booker; e.g. "offline") - Location type

Response 200 (Service location updated successfully) application/json:
- id* string - Service Location ID
- locationId* string - Location ID
- name* string - Location name
- slug* string - Unique URL-friendly identifier for the service location
- isActive boolean (default: true) - Whether location is active
- isPrivate boolean (default: false) - Whether location is private (not shown publicly)
- coverImage string - URL of the cover image displayed for this location
- locationType string (enum: offline | ask_booker) - Location type
- address string - Use a full street address when locationType is offline. Use a user-facing label when locationType is ask_booker.
- phone string - Contact phone number for the service location

Errors: 400, 401 (400: see Common error responses)
Response 401 (User not authenticated) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
- error string
